ALLOWED_ORIGINS.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Origins allowed to call the API from a browser

DATABASE_URL.name: DATABASE_URL
DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string for the orders database

REQUEST_TIMEOUT.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for handling one request

WEBHOOK_KEYS.name: WEBHOOK_KEYS
WEBHOOK_KEYS.description: Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks
WEBHOOK_KEYS.details: A webhook is accepted when it is signed with any key in the set, so the key can be rotated without turning webhooks away. Each key is 32 to 256 characters, so an empty or truncated key fails at boot. Without this variable, the service rejects every webhook.

WORKER_COUNT.name: WORKER_COUNT
WORKER_COUNT.description: Number of background workers processing orders
WORKER_COUNT.details: Each worker holds one database connection, so keep it below the database's connection limit divided by the number of replicas. Raise it when the order queue grows faster than it drains.

codes.description: Percent off for each discount code

serving-tls.name: serving-tls
serving-tls.description: Certificate to serve HTTPS with. Without it, the service serves HTTP
